context.context: This mosaic was created as part of a project commemorating those who served and sacrificed during World War One. Pte Beaney, born on 16 April 1893 in Battersea, London, served with The Queen's Regiment and was killed in action on 8 August 1916 in France. His image has been selected not only for its historical significance but for its emotional resonance in modern times. The project aims to engage audiences with a personal aspect of history, enabling individuals to connect with the faces that contributed to the mosaic, many of which represent the descendants or community members of those involved in World War One. The artwork serves as a means of remembrance, allowing the public to reflect on the sacrifices that were made in the past and fostering a sense of gratitude and respect for those who served.
